editorial.editors_note: As we continue to substitute rigorous engineering with the hollow theater of benchmark optimization, we are left to wonder if the tools we build still possess the integrity to support the structures we intend to raise.
editorial.emphasis: The transition from brittle, benchmark-driven AI performance to the precarious implementation of type-safe, regulated logic.
